attacker_pocs.name: index_memusage_after_decode
attacker_pocs.why: The Index decoder transfers its completed Index to the caller and clears coder->index. A subsequent public lzma_memusage() call enters the changed memconfig path, which passes that null pointer to lzma_index_block_count().

role_a_rationale: The change preserves the initial Record count in the estimate by adding Records already appended to the in-progress Index to the remaining count, so incremental lzma_memusage() no longer decreases as decoding proceeds. The same direct count query assumes the in-progress Index remains owned by the decoder after successful completion; the normal ownership transfer clears the pointer, leaving a null dereference on a later memory-usage query. The single accounting expression fits the existing code and passes the project tests.
